ld.description: In this guide, we will explain practical and easy-to-follow methods for effective cortizo windows maintenance suitable for Indian weather conditions.

step.name: Clean Frames with Mild Soap Solution
step.text: Wipe the frames gently and dry them immediately to prevent water spots. Use: Soft microfiber cloth, Mild soap mixed with water, Non-abrasive sponge.

step.name: Remove Dust from Tracks
step.text: Use a vacuum cleaner or soft brush. Remove visible dirt. Wipe with a damp cloth. Dry thoroughly.

step.name: Clean Glass Carefully
step.text: Use a standard glass cleaner or vinegar-water solution for streak-free glass cleaning. Clean during cooler hours. Avoid direct sunlight while cleaning. Use lint-free cloths.

step.name: Lubricate Moving Parts
step.text: Sliding systems, hinges, handles, and locks should be lubricated every few months. Recommended lubricants: Silicone spray, Light machine oil.

step.name: Check Handles and Locks
step.text: Inspect: Loose screws, Lock alignment, Handle stiffness. Tighten fittings when necessary to prevent long-term damage.

step.name: Avoid Harsh Chemicals
step.text: Strong chemical cleaners may damage protective coatings. Never use: Bleach, Ammonia-heavy cleaners, Acidic solutions.

step.name: Prevent Scratches
step.text: Use soft cloths only. Avoid dragging furniture near frames. Clean dirt particles before wiping.

step.name: Inspect Drainage Channels
step.text: Check for: Blockages, Mud accumulation, Leaves or debris. Blocked drainage channels can lead to water leakage inside the property.

step.name: Check Weather Seals
step.text: Inspect for: Cracks, Hardening, Loose edges. Damaged seals should be replaced promptly to maintain insulation and weather protection.

step.name: Schedule Professional Inspection
step.text: Professional inspection once a year is recommended. Professionals can identify: Hidden hardware issues, Alignment problems, Seal deterioration, Structural stress.
